[IRET.6.3] **Regex pre-compilation.** Regex alpha tests
compile the pattern string at RETP load time, not at
match time. The compiled regex object is stored in the
alpha node; pattern evaluation calls RE2
through `ds_re2_match`. There is no backend to choose: the
regex syntax **is** RE2 ([LREG.8.1]), so a swappable engine
would change which patterns compile ([IRET.23.1]).
